definitions.gloss: to be delighted, to be glad, to rejoice
definitions.explanation: To feel or express happiness about something.

examples.japanese: プレゼントをもらって{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: I was delighted to receive the present.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{合格|ごうかく}を{喜|よろこ}んでいる。
{喜|よろこ}んでお{手伝|てつだ}いします。
examples.notes: {喜|よろこ}んで = gladly, with pleasure

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Can be both. Pattern: Xを{喜|よろこ}ぶ (be happy about X) / Xが{喜|よろこ}ぶ (X is happy).

ASPECT: ている indicates state. {喜|よろこ}んでいる = 'is happy/delighted.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xを{喜|よろこ}ぶ (be happy about X)
・{喜|よろこ}んで (gladly, with pleasure)
・{喜|よろこ}ばせる (make someone happy—causative)
・{大喜|おおよろこ}び (great joy)
・お{喜|よろこ}び (congratulations—polite noun)

SET EXPRESSIONS:
・{喜|よろこ}んで！ (With pleasure! / Gladly!)
・お{喜|よろこ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます (Congratulations—formal)

RELATED:
・{喜|よろこ}び (joy, happiness—noun)
・{嬉|うれ}しい (happy, glad—adjective, more common in casual speech)
